acceptance_criteria.statement: Independently authored records have separate current-content files; Git stores their prior definitions and states.
Concurrent edits to the same current file use normal Git merge conflicts; Saga does not select a winner or create a second revision graph.
A supported write publishes a complete record or leaves no partial destination.

content.statement: As a developer collaborating in parallel, I can merge independently authored Saga records without editing one monolithic document so concurrent work remains reviewable and recoverable.
content.title: Merge independently authored knowledge

state.reason: Confirmed after the initial implementation investigation.
